request: 增加崩溃检测机制和崩溃代码显示
acceptance: Catch early first-party script/style failures, uncaught exceptions and unhandled rejections; show stable error code, incident ID, source position and redacted stack in a single independent nonmodal notice/detail viewer. Ignore expected aborts and ordinary image failures.

Bound and deduplicate reports; persist only safe metadata, never raw messages/stacks/secrets. Previous unclean tab termination is labelled uncertain. Locks hide diagnostics. No automatic reload, resend, cancellation or model calls.

Health checks use bounded timeout and consecutive failure threshold; offline/unreachable/restarted service remain distinct from confirmed JS/request panic. Pause probes in background/lock; detect real instance changes.

Server request panic has a stable diagnostic code/incident ID without exposing panic contents; preserve auth/CSP and streaming/hijack semantics. API failures report matching incidents without swallowing normal error handling.

Behavioral regressions, actual fault-injected isolated browser/server validation, native normal-runtime check, quick/full and authorized main/runtime/offline gates. Do not crash user production or original sessions.
scope: internal/server/web/app.js API error integration and system-log diagnostic entry
